jobs.title: Investment Portfolio Manager – Multi-Asset
jobs.description:
Investment Portfolio Manager – Multi-Asset

I’m supporting an investment organisation seeking an experienced professional to help manage portfolios across regional and international public markets.

The role will involve:

Assessing equity and fixed-income investment opportunities.
Selecting and reviewing external fund managers.
Supporting portfolio construction, allocation and rebalancing.
Analysing performance, investment risks and market developments.
Presenting recommendations to senior investment stakeholders.

You’ll ideally bring 7+ years’ experience
with an institutional investor, asset manager, family office or investment consultancy. Strong analytical skills and experience evaluating external managers are particularly relevant. CFA or a similar qualification would be advantageous.
